comments.author: basq
comments.story: How to Understand the Universe When You’re Stuck Inside of It
comments.why: Tutorial drawing and animating a mushroom on an oscilloscope
comments.text: What you've written is extremely interesting. Not sure how much of it I truly understand, but I wanted to add that your explanation for everything as a wave function reminded me of oscilloscope music, ie. depicting images with waveforms. A tutorial I watched demonstrates the drawing of a mushroom, then animates it by modulating with a larger wave. In my laymen's head model, Spacetime is like a very large wave that everything else is being modulated by. Here's the relevant video: [VIDEO]
